lines.label: Authority
lines.value: Agenzia Italiana del Farmaco (Italian Medicines Agency)

lines.label: What it holds
lines.value: Summaries of product characteristics and patient leaflets for all medicines authorised in Italy.

lines.label: Authorisation
lines.value: No medicine may be marketed in Italy without an AIFA authorisation; EU routes include the centralised procedure, in which the European Commission issues a binding decision, and the mutual recognition and decentralised procedures.

lines.label: Scheme
lines.value: AIC number (9 digits) and 2D Data Matrix unique identifier

lines.label: Rule
lines.value: Each pack is identified by a 9-digit AIC number. Under Legislative Decree 10/2025 and the Ministerial Decree of 6 March 2025 on Data Matrix technical specifications, the 2D barcode must contain only the unique identifier data. The '/E' suffix for centrally authorised products must not appear on any identifying element, including the pharmaceutical sticker, from 10 February 2027.
